verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official, first-party hosted MCP server (Zapier MCP). Its docs cover connecting any MCP client by creating a server and generating a connection token, plus security (SOC 2, OAuth, token auth), agentic vs managed modes, tool bundles and team access, giving agents action access across 9,000+ apps. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP connection works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect any MCP client to Zapier MCP by creating a server and generating a connection token, then adding it as a Bearer header or query parameter.
Give any MCP-compatible AI client governed access to 9,000+ apps through one connection: no code, no infrastructure, SOC 2 certified.
Zapier MCP lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any other AI client take real action in the apps that run your business — all with managed auth and permissions you control.
Zapier MCP security: SOC 2 Type II certified with SAML SSO, OAuth, and connection token auth.
official MCP server documented at https://zapier.com/mcp
